audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side (2+ items) is 'Skill' and phases[6].why describes a Swain advantage, but content win[6] already says 'Janna' and whys[6] correctly explains why she flips it (Zephyr slow, disengage Q, Monsoon peel/anti-dive) — the two layers disagree, matching the packet's own flagged defect about the chart not matching the 45.38% winrate.
audit.why: Content whys[6] and late are grounded in real Janna kit flags (W slow, Q knockup/zone, R heal+zone) and are directionally consistent with the sub-50% overall winrate; the full layer's phases[6] row was left on generic Swain-favoured template text.
audit.corrected: Move phases[6].side to 'Janna' and rewrite phases[6].why to describe her late kiting/peel advantage, matching win[6] (already correct, no content edit needed).

audit.why: Spikes correctly identify Lvl2 all-in kill window, Lvl6 as risky against Monsoon knockback, 1st item as still Swain, and Late as the flip to Janna's kite/peel kit.

Howling Gale as the tracked ability and E Nevermove as the all-in tool are both grounded correctly in enemyKit/ownerKit; the missing needs-antiheal interaction (Monsoon heal) is folded into the proposal below.

edits.before: Late support Swain anchors: root the entry, ascend the center, demonflare the formation.
edits.after: Two items on and Janna flips it: Zephyr slow and Howling Gale knockup keep you off her carry, and Monsoon knocks you out of drain range on command.

edits.before: - Janna Howling Gale: matchup-defining — The charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Nevermove banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Janna's Howling Gale (Q) charges up and is on a flat 14s cooldown — the tornado breaks every engage; bait it before committing the dive. - Keep E Nevermove (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: E the carrier, pull the fragment, Q the formation — one root taxed three bars and healed yours.
edits.after: Monsoon (R) heals through chip damage — buy anti-heal before you start a long trade or her ult undoes every point of poke you land.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 at marksman range — the demon era has a start date; respect it.
edits.after: Eye Of The Storm (E) shields whoever she points it at — brawl into a fresh shield and your trade just fed her carry free damage.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Commit on Howling Gale’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Howling Gale’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.
